- Handle edge cases: if list has fewer than 2 elements, return False; treat zero carefully (need at least two zeros to form a pair summing to zero).
- Iterate through the list once, maintaining a set of seen numbers; for each number x, check if its negation (-x) is in the set; if yes, return True; after check, add x to the set.
- After traversal, return False if no such pair found.
